# FreSound

> FreSound is a wireless open-ear earbud brand offering innovative directional audio technology for comfort, situational awareness, and lifestyle enhancement.

FreSound specializes in open-ear earbuds (FS01 Inspiration model) that use air conduction technology to deliver audio while keeping ears open to ambient sound. The site provides product information, user guides, customer support, and educational content about open-ear audio technology benefits.

## Key Topics

- Open-ear technology
- Wireless earbuds
- Air conduction
- FreSound Inspiration FS01
- IPX5 water resistance
- Bluetooth 5.3
- Comfort fit
- Situational awareness
- Hearing health
- Directional acoustics
- Earbud design
- Noise isolation
- Workout earbuds
- Gift guide
- Customer support
